claim_boundary: Exact algebraic jet only. Quantitative full-PDE remainder and novelty audit are separate. No singularity, uniform iteration, high-band relay dominance, or infinite cascade claim.
coefficient_convention: u(x)=sum_k uhat(k) exp(i k dot x)
equation: u'=L u+B(u,u); B_k(a,b)=-i P_k sum_{p+q=k}(a_p dot q)b_q

globally_smooth_reduced_seed_negative_co.definition: Delete only original seed modes +(0,0,1) and -(0,0,1); not a candidate search.
globally_smooth_reduced_seed_negative_co.invariant_class: x3-independent triangular 2D3C: u=(0,2*exp(-nu*t)*cos(x1),w(t,x1,x2)); w solves a scalar linear advection-diffusion equation with smooth bounded coefficients.
globally_smooth_reduced_seed_negative_co.scope: The selected two-generation observations alone do not distinguish the full 3D seed from this globally smooth class. This control is not a claim of global regularity for the full 3D seed.

invariant_class_checks.proof_no_invariant_spatial_direction: n dot e_j=0 for j=1,2,3 implies n=0

residual_convention: U'-LU-B(U,U)=t^2 r2+t^3 r3+t^4 r4; U=a+t b+t^2 c/2

specific_three_mode_similarity_obstructi.scope: Only this selected output triple cannot be a scalar times orthogonal image of the original orthonormal wavevectors. No exclusion of anisotropic, larger-packet, changed-profile, or other-seed mechanisms.
